criteria.rationale: The engine-required agent:independent- prefix is a declaration, not authenticated separation. Attestations here are unsigned; the missing Anthropic sealing-session reference is expected and no execution digest is invented. Fake adapters prove engine behavior, not vendor cognition or a vendor receipt.

Existing exclusive attempt and continuation claims, cancellation and containment remain intact. The final race selection and snapshot/continuity integrations passed; this delta changes bounded local parsing and deterministic selection, without adding shared execution state.

The CLI and policy additions implement the declared round protocol. Schema-1 projection and review-brief/1 digest reconstruction remain readable; typed drafts use the maintainer-chosen D3 contract, with genuine legacy fallback and no contradictory or malformed typed approval. Handoff-owned current sessions remain resumable in later rounds.

Named noncanonical fences, repeated external conflicts, duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, limits, reserved local identifiers and invented prior IDs refuse. Omitted and unevidenced findings stay open; invalid accounts are recorded and wait/provenance/approval refuse them. The first, second and third review regression corpus passes in the unit lane.

Generated briefs, dispatch, wait, verify, provenance and metrics consume the same canonical decision and ledger-derived round. The integration assessment was read: unobserved external MCP consumers are not evidence of a newly broken provider contract. Current delegation, provenance and continuity integrations pass.

Run, thread, invalid-draft, threshold and mode-convergence disclosures are consistent in machine and human surfaces, including active rows. Private session references remain redacted and stored privately. Metrics and derivation now select the same last-ending run with RunID tie-break.

The prior review-brief/1 template is preserved and matching runs still verify and continue. Existing resume/handoff/ledger/provenance contracts remain covered; new optional policy defaults are explicit and the stricter pose-draft contract is documented by D3. No claim is made that old engines can execute new round functionality. The narrower deprecated status projection is explicitly tracked by f-r4-01; the canonical replacement ls exposes the round.

All findings from the first three rounds are corrected. f-r4-01 is a separate accepted low-severity legacy-status presentation gap with owner and review date; it does not alter execution, account validation or approval. The registered full suite, negative corpus, latest-run selection and new third-review regression pass; the regression fails against f84812e production. Independent positive fence/permutation and composed handoff probes also pass.

R1-R5 derive round and open identities from the existing immutable ledger, with explicit typed accounts rather than interpreted prose. D1/D5 select continue-thread with full generated briefs, cold reasons and threshold; R7/R10 expose trajectories to judge that anchoring trade-off. The observed structural report matches the sealed subject and requires no material-fact mappings.

The four manual/scaffold copies, brief help and changelog describe the runtime round, decision, account, thread and convergence behavior. D3/D4/D5 record the maintainer decisions and corrections. The final report and requirement trace will record this review without changing Requirements, Technical Plan or Decisions.

Persisted runs, canonical delegate ls, verify and approval retain the correct round. The deprecation hint provides the replacement; ownership and review date are recorded in the finding and knowledge handoff.

R1/R8 recorded history and counts, R2-R5 quoted carry/account/identity, R6/R9 full-brief session continuity, and R7/R10 per-mode convergence are covered by the current unit and integration lanes. The composed independent probe confirms the deferred handoff R10 current-session integration.

The sealed change range contains the four implementing/correcting commits through fa0c589 and matches the declared artifacts. The narrow historical synthetic-fixture security exception and runtime fixture construction are declared and justified; no unrelated refactor, policy weakening or capability/adoption change is included.

Fail-closed typed decision/account boundaries, retained transcript/witness integrity, private session handling and run-backed approval checks were exercised. All previously demonstrated approval paths are refused. The exact pinned Gitleaks workflow command passes and its synthetic historical exception is fingerprint-scoped.

A bounded typed block, existing ledger and private resume command are sufficient; no parallel review-state system or prose inference was added. The falsifiers are an invalid draft accepted, a lost identity or divergent selection, now guarded by regressions. The accepted continue-thread choice remains measurable by mode trajectory and threshold rather than claiming cognition is proven.
